Image generation with explicit size parameter

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _request = try LiterLlm.createImageRequestFromJson("{\"model\":\"dall-e-3\",\"n\":1,\"prompt\":\"A sunset over mountains\",\"size\":\"1792x1024\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.imageGenerate(request: _request)
debugPrint(result.data)
debugPrint(result.data[0].url)
```
